contrast_rule.scope: Normal app-owned gray WorldClock text on observed white Root/own native sheet. No disabled native-field/icon restyling.
contrast_rule.method: Exact native ROI, minimum100neutral foreground pixels,35%nearwhite backdrop, sRGB actual100th-darkest foreground contrast>=4.5; darkestpixel separate upperbound. No resize/semantic-color/tiny-pixel/corner-black PASS. Uniform4.5 own target, no claimalllargefont minimums violated.
contrast_rule.reading: Observed native normal rectangle only, not wholeliteral/paragraph/assistive certificate. Largest-font contrast not qualified.
contrast_rule.future_exterior: Rootselected complete policy role, native-sheet complete zone/sun/model-policy roles only when original role-captures have identical fullnativeRGBA. Target rectangles+2nativeAApixels frozen before edit; no registration/mask expansion. Chooser visible multiple gray zones not all inventoried so exterior unqualified; positives Settings no changed roles.
